name: kestrel

documents.title: Refund policy
documents.text:
# Refunds

Refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days of receiving the returned item. Store credit is instant. Items must be unused and in their original packaging; opened software licences can't be refunded after fourteen days.

documents.title: Shipping policy
documents.text:
# Shipping

Hardware orders ship from our warehouse in Rotterdam within 24 hours on business days. Express delivery to most EU countries takes two days; worldwide shipping takes five to ten days. Tracking links are emailed when the parcel leaves the warehouse.

documents.title: Travel and expenses
documents.text:
# Travel and expenses

While travelling for work, meals are covered up to 45 euros per day. Book trains for trips under five hours and economy flights otherwise. Submit receipts in the expense tool within 30 days of the trip; later claims need a manager's approval.

documents.title: Remote work
documents.text:
# Remote work

Everyone may work remotely up to three days a week. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 Central European Time, when meetings may be scheduled. Working from another country for more than four weeks a year needs approval from People Operations.

documents.title: Annual leave
documents.text:
# Annual leave

Employees get 26 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays where they live. Up to five unused days carry over to the next year and must be taken before March 31. Request leave at least two weeks ahead for anything longer than three days.

documents.title: Parental leave
documents.text:
# Parental leave

The birth parent receives 20 weeks of fully paid leave. Partners and adoptive parents receive 12 weeks of fully paid leave, which can be split into up to three blocks within the child's first year.

documents.title: Security policy
documents.text:
# Security

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and unique to each service. Administrators must use a hardware security key. Cloud access keys are rotated every 90 days, and keys unused for 30 days are disabled automatically.

documents.title: Incident response
documents.text:
# Incident response

Incidents are graded from SEV1 (customers can't work) to SEV4 (cosmetic). The engineer on call must acknowledge a page within 15 minutes. Every SEV1 and SEV2 gets a blameless postmortem, published within five business days.

documents.title: Onboarding
documents.text:
# Onboarding

New hires receive their laptop on day one and meet an onboarding buddy in the first week. Production access is granted only after the security training is completed. The first month ends with a review with the manager.

documents.title: Code review
documents.text:
# Code review

Every pull request to the main branch needs two approvals and a green CI run. Authors never merge their own pull request without a review. Reviews should get a first response within one working day.

documents.title: Release process
documents.text:
# Releases

We release every second Tuesday. The code freeze starts on the Monday before at 12:00. Risky changes ship behind feature flags so they can be rolled back without a new release.

documents.title: Customer support
documents.text:
# Support

The support desk answers from 08:00 to 20:00 CET on weekdays; at weekends only email is monitored. Priority tickets get a first response within four hours, normal tickets within one business day.

documents.title: Plans and pricing
documents.text:
# Pricing

The Starter plan costs 29 euros a month for three seats. The Team plan costs 99 euros a month for up to fifteen seats. Enterprise pricing is agreed per contract. Paying annually gives two months free.

documents.title: Data retention
documents.text:
# Data retention

Application logs are kept for 30 days and backups for 35 days. When a contract ends, customer data is deleted 60 days later, unless the customer asks for earlier deletion.

documents.title: Privacy requests
documents.text:
# Privacy requests

Data subject access requests are answered within 30 days. Send them to the privacy mailbox. Our data protection officer, Tomas Weber, reviews every request before it is answered.

documents.title: Laptops and equipment
documents.text:
# Equipment

Laptops are replaced every three years; you may choose a MacBook Pro or a ThinkPad. External monitors, keyboards and headsets are available on request through the IT portal.

documents.title: Lisbon office
documents.text:
# Lisbon office

The Lisbon office is on Avenida da Liberdade and has 40 desks. It is open from 08:00 to 19:00. Desks are booked through the office app; the terrace is reserved for events on Fridays.

documents.title: Berlin office
documents.text:
# Berlin office

The Berlin office is in Kreuzberg, close to the canal, with 60 desks and four meeting rooms. Mateo Ruiz is the site lead and the person to ask about access badges.

documents.title: Project Orion
documents.text:
# Project Orion

Project Orion is the new search platform, led by Priya Nair. It replaces keyword search with hybrid retrieval and is scheduled to launch in the third quarter.

documents.title: Project Atlas
documents.text:
# Project Atlas

Project Atlas migrates billing to the new invoicing engine. It is run by Mateo Ruiz and must be finished by the end of November, before the annual renewals start.

documents.title: Project Helix
documents.text:
# Project Helix

Project Helix rewrites the mobile app in React Native so one team can ship to both platforms. Amara Okafor leads the project.

documents.title: Priya Nair
documents.text:
# Priya Nair

Priya Nair is a principal engineer who works from the Lisbon office. Before joining Kestrel Labs she spent six years at Northwind Analytics. She mentors the new search engineers.

documents.title: Mateo Ruiz
documents.text:
# Mateo Ruiz

Mateo Ruiz is an engineering manager based in Berlin. He joined Kestrel Labs in 2019 and runs the platform group.

documents.title: Amara Okafor
documents.text:
# Amara Okafor

Amara Okafor is the design lead. She works remotely from Lagos and reports to Lena Fischer.

documents.title: Lena Fischer
documents.text:
# Lena Fischer

Lena Fischer is the product director, based in Berlin. She owns the product roadmap and signs off every pricing change.

documents.title: Tomas Weber
documents.text:
# Tomas Weber

Tomas Weber works part-time for Kestrel Labs from Vienna. He studied law in Graz and teaches a course on privacy law.

documents.title: Platform group
documents.text:
# Platform group

The platform group runs the Kubernetes clusters, the CI runners and the observability stack. Its on-call rotation changes every Monday. Mateo Ruiz runs the group.

documents.title: Northwind Analytics
documents.text:
# Northwind Analytics

Northwind Analytics has been our analytics vendor since 2021. The contract renews every January. Our account manager there is Elif Demir.

documents.title: Billing FAQ
documents.text:
# Billing questions

Invoices are sent on the first business day of the month. You can pay by card or bank transfer. Businesses in the EU with a VAT number are invoiced with the reverse charge.

documents.title: Account FAQ
documents.text:
# Account questions

Password reset links are valid for one hour. Single sign-on through SAML is available on the Enterprise plan only. Two-factor authentication is required for every administrator.
